notes: The *with* of *fed thee with manna* joins the verb's unit under rule 44's supplied-preposition clause, no object marker standing on man here — the contrasting shape is DEU.8.3, where a marker is present and takes the word under rule 16.
Both lema'an units take the complementizer and leave the supplied subject and modal to the infinitive (rule 52).
acharit -> *latter end* is headed on *end*, the ASV writing that noun alone for the word elsewhere; the competing head on *latter* under rule 31's ordinary case is named in the unit's note.
